info.name: Sugarloop API — v1
info.description:
Every endpoint implemented so far (Sprint 1, Steps 1-4 + 7).

Run the whole thing with the Collection Runner, top to bottom — requests depend on variables set by earlier ones (branchId, accessToken, productSlug). Running a single request out of order may fail for that reason alone.

Requires: the API on {{baseUrl}}, MongoDB reachable, and `npm run seed` already run.

NOT YET BUILT (they will 404 — that is expected, not a bug): /checkout/quote, /orders, /auth/otp/*, /enquiries, /staff/orders, /staff/stock, /staff/products, /staff/reports.
